newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares up in shortened pre-Easter trade.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares up in shortened pre-Easter trade.

text.p: Norwegian shares rose in lacklustre trade on Wednesday in a session cut short by the Easter holidays.
The Total index closed 0.36 percent up at 1,076.57 points in turnover worth only 363 million crowns.
The bourse closed four hours early as the country began celebrating Easter.

Norwegian Cruise Lines (NCL) jumped 10.2 percent to finish at 20.50 crowns after Saudi Arabia's billionaire Prince al-Waleed bin Talal said he had agreed to buy a five percent stake in it worth $20 million.
Shares totalling 19.8 million crowns were traded in NCL.
Industrial giant Norsk Hydro was the most traded share of the session at 60 million crowns. The share finished unchanged at 330 crowns.
